Name: Calico Desert Bus
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[youtube]QeRcycSK390[/youtube]

aka. [i]Pam and Penny's Smoke and Mirrors, Journey of the Prairie King: A New Hope, Speed 3, Drive to the Desert, How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bus,[/i] etc.

[size=3][color=#e69138][b]Features[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*]Realistic bus simulation reacts to all four directional keys
[*]Immersive transition between the bus stop and desert
[*]Over 360 miles of open road to explore
[*]Rich game world showcasing true day-night cycle
[*]Pass out when you crash the bus (optional)
[*]8+ hours of exciting gameplay
[/list]
.. but wait, THERE'S MORE!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9jQYRC2.png[/img]   [size=3][color=#e69138][b]Pam & Penny's CALICO DESERT BUS™ Challenge[/b][/color][/size]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/9jQYRC2.png[/img]

If you can name the exact model of bus featured in CALICO DESERT BUS™, you're eligible to participate in the GRAND SWEEPSTAKES!
Select winners will receive ONE (1) point, and the chance to change a pixel of our choosing on the CALICO DESERT BUS™ spritesheet.
Proof of original thought must be provided. Entries with computer-generated or fraudulent information will be incinerated.
Point and pixel edit form will be sent by return mail at the sender's expense. International postage not accepted.

Entries may be sent by domestic mail to the following address:

[quote]    Pam & Penny's CALICO DESERT BUS™ Challenge
    PO Box 601093
    42 Wallaby Way
    Sydney, NSW 2000[/quote]

[size=3][color=#e69138][b]Rewards[/b][/color][/size]

Career drivers earn exclusive & secret rewards for long-distance driving over any number of trips:
[list][size=3]
[*][b]1,000 meters[/b]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/b40o0T8.png[/img]  Bus Driver Top
[*][b]10,000 meters[/b]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/RmFttkt.png[/img]  Bus Driver Pants
[*][b]100,000 meters[/b]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/Cdv95u9.png[/img]  Cursed CALICO DESERT BUS™ Arcade System
[*][b]1,000,000 meters[/b]   [img]https://i.imgur.com/xNCofAE.png[/img]   Keys to the Bus
[/size][/list]

[size=3][color=#e69138][b]Controls[/b][/color][/size]

Driver's license not required.

[list][size=3]
[*][b]WASD[/b]  –  Drive the bus
[*][b]Left-mouse[/b]  –  Honk
[*][b]Right-mouse[/b]  –  Doors
[*][b]Esc[/b]  –  Quit (skip to destination in bus transition)
[/size][/list]

[size=3][color=#e69138][b]Config[/b][/color][/size]

You probably don't want these turned on. They're turned on anyway.

[list][size=3]
[*][b]BusTravel[/b]  –  Replace the bus transition
[*][b]ArcadeGame[/b]  –  Replace the JOTPK arcade machine
[*][b]AbigailGame[/b]  –  Replace Abigail's 2-hearts event minigame
[*][b]PassOut[/b]  –  Pass out when you crash out (bus transition only)
[/size][/list]
